passage.text: Read Together, a non-profit organization, is looking for volunteers for an English camp in Nan province.
passage.reading: ˈriːd təˈɡɛðər, ə ˌnɑːnˈprɑːfɪt ˌɔːrɡənəˈzeɪʃən, ɪz ˈlʊkɪŋ fər ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz fər ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈkæmp ɪn ˈnɑːn ˈprɑːvɪns.

passage.text: The camp will be held at a village school on the second weekend of March.
passage.reading: ðə ˈkæmp wɪl bi ˈhɛld ət ə ˈvɪlɪdʒ ˈskuːl ɑːn ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈwiːkɛnd əv ˈmɑːrtʃ.

passage.text: Volunteers will teach English songs and games to children from seven to twelve years old.
passage.reading: ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz wɪl ˈtiːtʃ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈsɔːŋz ənd ˈɡeɪmz tə ˈtʃɪldrən frəm ˈsɛvən tə ˈtwɛlv ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld.

passage.text: No teaching experience is necessary, but a minimum level of English is required.
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈtiːtʃɪŋ ɪkˈspɪriəns ɪz ˈnɛsəsɛri, bʌt ə ˈmɪnɪməm ˈlɛvəl əv ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz rɪˈkwaɪərd.

passage.text: All volunteers must be at least eighteen years old.
passage.reading: ˈɔːl ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz mʌst bi ət ˈliːst ˌeɪˈtiːn ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld.

passage.text: We will provide transportation from Bangkok, meals and accommodation.
passage.reading: wiː wɪl prəˈvaɪd ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk, ˈmiːlz ənd əˌkɑːməˈdeɪʃən.

passage.text: Volunteers will stay with local families in the village.
passage.reading: ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz wɪl ˈsteɪ wɪð ˈloʊkəl ˈfæməliz ɪn ðə ˈvɪlɪdʒ.

passage.text: Please bring your own towel and water bottle.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ jʊr ˈoʊn ˈtaʊəl ənd ˈwɔːtər ˌbɑːtəl.

passage.text: Places are limited, so please register by February 20th.
passage.reading: ˈpleɪsɪz ər ˈlɪmɪtɪd, soʊ ˈpliːz ˈrɛdʒɪstər baɪ ˈfɛbruɛri ˈtwɛntiəθ.

passage.text: To register, fill out the form on our website.
passage.reading: tə ˈrɛdʒɪstər, ˈfɪl ˈaʊt ðə ˈfɔːrm ɑːn aʊər ˈwɛbsaɪt.

passage.text: We ask each volunteer for a minimum donation of 500 baht to cover the cost of food.
passage.reading: wiː ˈæsk ˈiːtʃ ˌvɑːlənˈtɪr fər ə ˈmɪnɪməm doʊˈneɪʃən əv ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt tə ˈkʌvər ðə ˈkɔːst əv ˈfuːd.

passage.text: If you have any questions, please send an email to Daniel.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz, ˈpliːz ˈsɛnd ən ˈiːmeɪl tə ˈdænjəl.
